newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cultus says Cornea evaluation planned.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cultus says Cornea evaluation planned.

text.p: Cultus Petroleum NL said on Wednesday a multi well and seismic exploration and appraisal programme is being prepared to evaluate the Cornea oil discovery in the Browse Basin offshore Western Australia.
Drilling at Cornea in WA-241-P had proven a minimum 20 metre gross oil column with the potential for a 50m column, the junior oil and gas producer said.
The find was initially reported late last month.
The exploration and appraisal programme was expected to start during the third or fourth quarters of 1997, it said.
Permit WA-241-P is operated by Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Development (Australia) Pty Ltd with 50 percent, while Cultus and Chevron Corp unit Chevron Asiatic Ltd each hold 25 percent.
